packageRules.description: Skip HMCTS feature-branch builds published with a ticket suffix (e.g. 4.1.0-CCD-8220, 9.2.12_CCD-8388). Maven versioning ranks unknown qualifiers above the release, so Renovate otherwise treats them as the newest stable version. Kept first so the package-specific allowedVersions rules below still override it
Version 6 moves to Jackson 3 (tools.jackson), which the CCD SDK's Jackson 2 guard rejects; take 5.x until the service moves to Jackson 3

Byte Buddy 1.18.16 and 1.18.17 stop Mockito mocking CaseData on Java 25 ('Could not modify all classes'), aborting EventHistoryMapperTest. 1.18.15 fails the same way (ASM LimitExceededException: Too many operations). Later versions are still offered, in their own Byte Buddy group, so CI can confirm a fix
Hold actions/setup-python below 3.15: semgrep 1.177.0 needs ruamel.yaml.clib 0.2.15, which has no 3.15 build (pii-log-check), and the email-docs generator tests fail on 3.15
These BOMs only set CVE minimums (DTSCCI-6473): take patch releases on the Reactor and Micrometer lines Spring Boot manages, and move to a new line together with Spring Boot
Keep the Terraform CLI version (infrastructure/.terraform-version) out of the npm non-major group; large jumps can affect state and providers, so review and merge manually
Keep the cnp-jenkins-library @Library bump in Jenkinsfiles out of the npm non-major group so pipeline changes are tested on their own

Keep Byte Buddy out of the non-major group: from 1.18.15 (ASM 9.11) Mockito cannot instrument CaseData ('Too many operations'), so a Byte Buddy update that fails the unit tests would otherwise hold back every other non-major update
Camunda upgrades are isolated in their own group and require manual review to prevent build failures
DTSCCI-7065: Hold CCD chart updates until the chart size regression is resolved and the packaged civil-service chart is safely below the size limit
Require manual review of AAC chart updates because the chart also bundles CCD
